title: Ticket Booking (BookMyShow)
prompt: Design a movie/event ticket booking system like BookMyShow. Users browse shows, pick specific seats, hold them for a few minutes while paying, and get a confirmed booking. Popular shows sell out in minutes.
functionalReqs: Browse events and see the seat map
Select seats and hold them for ~10 minutes
Release seats if payment fails or the hold expires
nonFunctionalReqs: Seat map reads are fast and highly available
Survives traffic spikes for popular releases
